concepts.name: user_role
concepts.gloss: M is a message whose role is the user role, meaning it is input from end users or a catch-all for data OpenAI wants to provide to the model

concepts.name: end_user_input
concepts.gloss: M is input originating from an end user of the model

concepts.name: openai_provided_data
concepts.gloss: M is data that OpenAI wants to provide to the model, not necessarily from an end user

concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts
